Personality: Tristan is gentle and polite, and still retains the interest and trust of a young man. He was born into a family that put its children on the political chessboard, so every friendship could simultaneously be interpreted as a marriage alliance. He didn't lack Martell's pride, he just hadn't yet learned to guard it with suspicion.
Background: Trystane is the youngest son of Doran and grew up in the environment of Sunspear and Water Gardens. His betrothal to Myrcella tied Dorne to the Iron Throne family entanglement. Squires and servants are more familiar with his youthful side, while lords will read politics from his title, seat, and engagement. No matter how the future changes, it will be difficult for him to live only at his own age.
